verdict.rationale: Jules has a usage-limits docs page that lists plan tiers, including a "Power users & agent-heavy workflows" tier with figures of 300 and 60. A community report confirms plan-based daily task limits (the free plan dropped from 60 to 15). So plan-based limits clearly exist and are documented, but the evidence only shows that they can be seen in the docs, not managed. Missing for 10: explicit labeling of which figure is daily tasks and which is concurrency, an in-product view of current usage against limits, documented ways to manage or adjust limits or upgrade plans, and team or admin-level limit controls.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows

citations.quote: The daily task limit went down from 60 to 15 (on the free plan) with this release.
